kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-db-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-type MySQL --db-version 5.6 --pay-type Postpaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBCluster

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available zones
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可选的可用区。
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The CPU architecture. Valid values:
X86
ARM
parameters.help_zh:
CPU 架构。取值范围如下：
X86
ARM
parameters.name: architecture

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database engine. Valid values: 

MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值范围如下： 

MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The database DPI engine version number.
Valid values for MySQL version number: 
    * 5.6
    * 5.7
    * 8.0
Valid values for PostgreSQL version number:
    * 11
    * 14
    * 15
    <props="china">
      
      > To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL, only version 14 is supported. 
    
    </props>
Valid values for Oracle version number:
    * 11
    * 14
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎版本号。
MySQL版本号取值范围如下： 
    * 5.6
    * 5.7
    * 8.0
PostgreSQL版本号取值范围如下：
    * 11
    * 14
    * 15
    <props="china">
      
      > PolarDB PostgreSQL版中如需创建Serverless集群，版本号只支持14。 
    
    </props>
Oracle版本号取值范围如下：
    * 11
    * 14
parameters.name: db_version

parameters.help_en:
The node specification. For more information, see the following topics:

PolarDB for MySQL: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html.
PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle): https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207921.html.
PolarDB for PostgreSQL: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209380.html.

To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, set this parameter to polar.mysql.sl.small.
To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition, set this parameter to polar.mysql.sl.small.c.
To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL Cluster Edition, set this parameter to polar.pg.sl.small.
To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL Standard Edition, set this parameter to polar.pg.sl.small.c.
To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle), set this parameter to polar.o.sl.small
parameters.help_zh:
节点规格，详情请参见如下文档：

PolarDB MySQL版：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html。
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207921.html。
PolarDB PostgreSQL版：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209380.html。

PolarDB MySQL集群版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入polar.mysql.sl.small。
PolarDB MySQL标准版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入polar.mysql.sl.small.c。
PolarDB PostgreSQL集群版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入polar.pg.sl.small。
PolarDB PostgreSQL标准版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入polar.pg.sl.small.c。
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）如需创建Serverless集群，请传入polar.o.sl.small
parameters.name: db_node_class

parameters.help_en: The network type of the cluster. Only virtual private clouds (VPCs) are supported. Set the value to VPC
parameters.help_zh: 集群网络类型，当前仅支持专有网络，取值固定为VPC
parameters.name: cluster_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cluster. The name must meet the following requirements:
It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
集群名称，集群名称需满足如下要求：
不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false.

This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，取值范围如下：

true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

默认为false。

当参数PayType取值为Prepaid时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
This is a required parameter to pass when PayType is set to Prepaid. Specifies the subscription type of the subscription cluster. 

Year: annual subscription.
Month: monthly subscription
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

Year：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
Month：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid.
If Period is set to Month, UsedTime is an integer that ranges from `[1-9]`.
If Period is set to Year, UsedTime is an integer that ranges from `[1-3]`
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。
当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

If you specify VPCId, you must also specify VSwitchId
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。

如果已选择VPCId，则VSwitchId必选
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The method used to create the cluster. Valid values: 

Normal: creates a new PolarDB cluster. For more information about console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58769.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118063.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118182.html

CloneFromPolarDB: clones data from an existing PolarDB cluster to a new PolarDB cluster. For more information about console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87966.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118108.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118221.html

RecoverFromRecyclebin: restores data from a released PolarDB cluster to a new PolarDB cluster. For more information about console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164880.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432844.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424632.html

CloneFromRDS: clones data from an existing ApsaraDB RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. For more information about console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121812.html.

MigrationFromRDS: migrates data from an existing ApsaraDB RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. The created PolarDB cluster is in read-only pattern and has Binlog enabled by default. For more information about console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html.

CreateGdnStandby: creates a secondary cluster. For more information about console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html.

UpgradeFromPolarDB: performs instance migration and upgrade from PolarDB. For more information about console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html.

Default value: Normal.

When DBType is set to MySQL and DBVersion is set to 8.0, you can set this parameter to CreateGdnStandby
parameters.help_zh:
创建方式，取值范围如下： 

Normal：创建一个全新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58769.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118063.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118182.html

CloneFromPolarDB：从现有PolarDB集群克隆数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87966.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118108.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118221.html

RecoverFromRecyclebin：从已释放的PolarDB集群恢复数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164880.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432844.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424632.html

CloneFromRDS：从现有RDS实例克隆数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121812.html；

MigrationFromRDS：从现有RDS实例迁移数据到新的PolarDB集群。创建的PolarDB集群是只读模式，且默认开启Binlog。控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html。

CreateGdnStandby：创建一个从集群，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html。

UpgradeFromPolarDB：从PolarDB升级迁移，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html。

默认为Normal。

当DBType为MySQL且DBVersion为8.0时，本参数取值可以为CreateGdnStandby
parameters.name: creation_option

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance or the source PolarDB cluster. This parameter is required only when CreationOption is set to MigrationFromRDS, CloneFromRDS, CloneFromPolarDB, or RecoverFromRecyclebin.
If CreationOption is set to MigrationFromRDS or CloneFromRDS, set this parameter to instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. The source ApsaraDB RDS instance must run ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL 5.6, 5.7, or 8.0 High-availability Edition.

If CreationOption is set to CloneFromPolarDB, set this parameter to instance ID of the source PolarDB cluster. The cloned cluster and the source cluster use the same DBType by default. For example, if the source cluster runs MySQL 8.0, set DBType to MySQL and DBVersion to 8.0 for the cloned cluster.
If CreationOption is set to RecoverFromRecyclebin, set this parameter to instance ID of the released source PolarDB cluster. The restored cluster and the source cluster must use the same DBType. For example, if the source cluster runs MySQL 8.0, set DBType to MySQL and DBVersion to 8.0 for the restored cluster
parameters.help_zh:
源RDS实例ID或源PolarDB集群ID。仅当CreationOption为MigrationFromRDS、CloneFromRDS、CloneFromPolarDB或RecoverFromRecyclebin时，该参数必填。
若CreationOption为MigrationFromRDS或CloneFromRDS，您需要为本参数传入源RDS实例ID。源RDS实例版本需为RDS MySQL 5.6 、5.7或8.0高可用版。

若CreationOption为CloneFromPolarDB，您需要为本参数传入源PolarDB集群ID。克隆集群和源集群的DBType默认保持一致。例如源集群为MySQL 8.0，则克隆集群也需设置DBType为MySQL且DBVersion为8.0。
若CreationOption为RecoverFromRecyclebin，您需要为本参数传入已释放的源PolarDB集群ID。从回收站恢复的集群和源集群的DBType需保持一致。例如源集群为MySQL 8.0，则从回收站恢复的集群也需设置DBType为MySQL且DBVersion为8.0
parameters.name: source_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time at which data is cloned. Valid values: 

LATEST: the latest point in time.
BackupID: a historical backup set ID. Set this parameter to the specific backup set ID.
Timestamp: a historical point in time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).

 Default value: LATEST.

If CreationOption is set to CloneFromRDS, this parameter can only be set to LATEST
parameters.help_zh:
克隆数据的时间节点，取值： 

LATEST：最新时间点的数据。
BackupID：历史备份集ID，请传入具体的备份集ID。
Timestamp：历史时间点，请传入具体的时间，格式：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）。

 默认为LATEST。

若CreationOption为CloneFromRDS，则本参数取值只能为LATEST
parameters.name: clone_data_point

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP whitelist of the PolarDB cluster.
You can configure multiple IP addresses in the whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB集群白名单IP地址。
支持配置多个白名单IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). Valid values:

true: enables TDE.
false: disables TDE (default).

This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to PostgreSQL or Oracle.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167982.html operation to enable TDE for a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.
After TDE is enabled, it cannot be disabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启TDE加密。取值范围如下：

true：开启。
false：关闭（默认值）。

仅当DBType为PostgreSQL或Oracle时，本参数生效。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167982.html接口为PolarDB MySQL集群开启TDE加密。
TDE功能开启后不可关闭
parameters.name: tde_status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Global Database Network (GDN).

This parameter is required when CreationOption is set to CreateGdnStandby
parameters.help_zh:
全球数据库网络ID。

当CreationOption为CreateGdnStandby时，本参数必填
parameters.name: gdn_id

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the cluster. Valid values:
Normal: Cluster Edition (default).
Basic: Single Node Edition.
ArchiveNormal: PolarDB X-Engine Edition.
NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster Edition.
SENormal: Standard Edition.

MySQL 5.6, 5.7, 8.0, PostgreSQL 14, and Oracle syntax-compatible 2.0 support Basic.
MySQL 8.0 supports ArchiveNormal and NormalMultimaster.
MySQL 5.6, 5.7, 8.0, and PostgreSQL 14 support SENormal.

For more information about editions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html
parameters.help_zh:
产品系列，取值范围如下：
Normal：集群版（默认值）
Basic：单节点
ArchiveNormal：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）
NormalMultimaster：多主架构集群版
SENormal：标准版

MySQL 5.6、5.7、8.0，PostgreSQL 14以及Oracle语法兼容 2.0版支持Basic。
MySQL 8.0支持ArchiveNormal和NormalMultimaster。
MySQL 5.6、5.7、8.0和PostgreSQL 14支持SENormal。

更多关产品系列的介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html
parameters.name: creation_category

parameters.help_en:
The default time zone of the cluster (UTC). The value can be any time frame within the range of -12:00 to +13:00, such as 00:00. Default value: SYSTEM, which indicates that the default time zone is the same as the time zone of the region.
This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
集群时区（UTC），可选取值范围为-12:00~+13:00内的所有整点时间，如00:00。默认取值为SYSTEM，默认时区与Region所在时区一致。
仅当DBType为MySQL时，该参数生效
parameters.name: default_time_zone

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether table names are case-sensitive. Valid values:
1: Table names are case-insensitive.
0: Table names are case-sensitive.

Default value: 1.
This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
表名是否区分大小写，取值范围如下：
1：不区分大小写
0：区分大小写

默认取值为1。
仅当DBType为MySQL时，该参数生效
parameters.name: lower_case_table_names

parameters.help_en:
The data retention policy applied when the cluster is deleted. Valid values:
ALL: long-term retention (LTR) of all backups.
LATEST: long-term retention (LTR) of the last backup (an automatic backup is performed before deletion).
NONE: does not retain backups upon cluster deletion.

When a cluster is created, the default value is NONE, which means backups are not retained upon cluster deletion.
This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL.
Serverless clusters do not support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
删除集群时备份集保留策略，取值范围如下：
ALL：长期保留全部备份。
LATEST：长期保留最后一个备份（删除前自动备份）。
NONE：集群删除时不保留备份集。

创建集群时，默认取值为NONE，即集群删除时不保留备份集。
仅当DBType为MySQL时，该参数生效。
Serverless集群不支持该参数
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion

parameters.help_en:
The storage space for subscription (pay-by-space) billing. Unit: GB.
Valid values for PolarDB for MySQL Enterprise Edition: 10 to 50000.
Valid values for PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition: 20 to 64000.
When the storage type of Standard Edition is ESSDAUTOPL, valid values are 40 to 64000 with a minimum step of 10, meaning only values such as 40, 50, 60, and so on are accepted
parameters.help_zh:
按空间计费（包年包月）的存储空间。单位：GB。
PolarDB MySQL企业版存储空间的取值范围：10~50000。
PolarDB MySQL标准版存储空间的取值范围：20~64000。
标准版存储类型为ESSDAUTOPL时，存储空间的取值范围：40~64000，步长最小为10，即只能填写40、50、60...以此类推
parameters.name: storage_space

parameters.help_en:
The minor version of the database engine. Valid values:

8.0.2

8.0.1

This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL and DBVersion is set to 8.0
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎小版本号。取值范围如下：

8.0.2

8.0.1

当参数DBType为MySQL且DBVersion为8.0时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: db_minor_version

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parameter template.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207178.html operation to query the list of parameter templates in the target region, including parameter template IDs
parameters.help_zh:
参数模板ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207178.html接口查看目标地域的参数模板列表，包括参数模板ID
parameters.name: parameter_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. To add multiple tags to the target cluster at a time, click Add to add tag keys.

You can add up to 20 tag pairs at a time. `Tag.N.Key` corresponds to `Tag.N.Value`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。若您需要为目标集群一次性添加多个标签，请单击添加增加标签键。

每次最多添加20对标签，`Tag.N.Key`对应的值为`Tag.N.Value`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. To add multiple tags to the target cluster at a time, click Add to add tag values.

You can add up to 20 tag pairs at a time. `Tag.N.Value` corresponds to `Tag.N.Key`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。若您需要为目标集群一次性添加多个标签，请单击添加增加标签值。

每次最多添加20对标签，`Tag.N.Value`对应的值为`Tag.N.Key`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The serverless type. Set the value to AgileServerless (agile).
Only serverless clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless类型。当前取值固定为AgileServerless（敏态）。
仅Serverless集群支持该参数
parameters.name: serverless_type

parameters.help_en:
The minimum scaling limit for a single node. Valid values: 1 PCU to 31 PCU.

Only serverless clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
单节点伸缩下限。取值范围：1 PCU~31 PCU。

仅Serverless集群支持该参数
parameters.name: scale_min

parameters.help_en:
The maximum scaling limit for a single node. Valid values: 1 PCU to 32 PCU.
Only serverless clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
单节点伸缩上限。取值范围：1 PCU~32 PCU。
仅Serverless集群支持该参数
parameters.name: scale_max

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable No-activity Suspension. Valid values:

true: enables No-activity Suspension.

false: disables No-activity Suspension (default).
Only serverless clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启无活动暂停。取值：

true：开启

false：关闭（默认）
仅Serverless集群支持该参数
parameters.name: allow_shut_down

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.
Only serverless clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
只读节点个数伸缩下限。取值范围：0~15。
仅Serverless集群支持该参数
parameters.name: scale_ro_num_min

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.
Only serverless clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
只读节点个数伸缩上限。取值范围：0~15。
仅Serverless集群支持该参数
parameters.name: scale_ro_num_max

parameters.help_en:
Valid values for Enterprise Edition storage type:
PSL5
PSL4

Valid values for Standard Edition storage type:
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1
ESSDPL2
ESSDPL3
ESSDAUTOPL
parameters.help_zh:
企业版存储类型取值如下：
PSL5
PSL4

标准版存储类型取值如下：
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1
ESSDPL2
ESSDPL3
ESSDAUTOPL
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes for Standard Edition and Enterprise Edition. Valid values:
Standard Edition: 1 to 8 (supports 1 read/write node and 7 read-only nodes).
Enterprise Edition: 1 to 16 (supports 1 read/write node and 15 read-only nodes).
Enterprise Edition has 2 nodes by default, and Standard Edition has 1 node by default.
Only PolarDB for MySQL supports this parameter.
Changing the number of nodes for Multi-master Cluster Edition clusters is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
标准版和企业版节点个数。取值如下：
标准版取值范围：1~8（支持1个读写节点和7个只读节点）。
企业版取值范围：1~16（支持1个读写节点和15个只读节点）。
企业版默认有2个节点，标准版默认有1个节点。
仅PolarDB MySQL版支持该参数。
目前暂不支持多主集群节点数量变更设置
parameters.name: db_node_num

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:

ON (default): enables the hot standby storage cluster.
OFF: disables the hot standby cluster.
STANDBY: enables the hot standby cluster.
EQUAL: enables both the hot standby storage cluster and the hot standby compute cluster.
3AZ: enables multi-zone strong data consistency.
STANDBY takes effect only for PolarDB for PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启热备集群。取值范围如下：

ON（默认）：开启存储热备集群。
OFF：关闭热备集群。
STANDBY：开启热备集群。
EQUAL：开启存储热备和计算热备。
3AZ：多可用区数据强一致。
STANDBY 仅对PolarDB PostgreSQL版生效
parameters.name: hot_standby_cluster

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

ON: Multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled. This value applies to the Standard Edition three-zone deployment scenario.

OFF: Multi-zone strong data consistency is not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
集群是否开启了多可用区数据强一致。取值范围如下：

ON：表示开启了多可用区数据强一致，适用于标准版3AZ场景。

OFF：表示未开启多可用区数据强一致
parameters.name: strict_consistency

parameters.help_en:
The zone of the hot standby cluster.

This parameter takes effect only when the hot standby cluster or multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
热备集群的可用区。

开启了热备集群或多可用区数据强一致，该参数才生效
parameters.name: standby_az

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database proxy. Valid values:
EXCLUSIVE: Dedicated Enterprise Edition.
GENERAL: Standard Enterprise Edition.
The proxy type must match the type that corresponds to the node specifications of the cluster:
If the node specifications are General-purpose, set the proxy type to Standard Enterprise Edition.
If the node specifications are Dedicated, set the proxy type to Dedicated Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
数据库代理类型，取值范围如下：
EXCLUSIVE：企业独享版
GENERAL：企业通用版
代理类型需要与集群的节点规格对应的类型保持一致。即：
节点规格为通用规格，则代理类型应为企业通用版；
节点规格为独享规格，则代理类型应为企业独享版
parameters.name: proxy_type

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the database proxy for Standard Edition. Valid values:

polar.maxscale.g2.medium.c: 2 cores.
polar.maxscale.g2.large.c: 4 cores.
polar.maxscale.g2.xlarge.c: 8 cores.
polar.maxscale.g2.2xlarge.c: 16 cores.
polar.maxscale.g2.3xlarge.c: 24 cores.
polar.maxscale.g2.4xlarge.c: 32 cores.
polar.maxscale.g2.8xlarge.c: 64 cores
parameters.help_zh:
标准版数据库代理规格。取值如下：

polar.maxscale.g2.medium.c：2核。
polar.maxscale.g2.large.c：4核。
polar.maxscale.g2.xlarge.c：8核。
polar.maxscale.g2.2xlarge.c：16核。
polar.maxscale.g2.3xlarge.c：24核。
polar.maxscale.g2.4xlarge.c：32核。
polar.maxscale.g2.8xlarge.c：64核
parameters.name: proxy_class

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Binlog feature. Valid values:

ON: enables the Binlog feature for the cluster.
OFF: disables the Binlog feature for the cluster.
This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
开启Binlog功能，取值范围如下：

ON：集群开启Binlog功能。
OFF：集群关闭Binlog功能。
当参数DBType为MySQL时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: loose_polar_log_bin

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the X-Engine storage engine. Valid values:

ON: enables the X-Engine storage engine for the cluster.
OFF: disables the X-Engine storage engine for the cluster.
This parameter takes effect only when CreationOption is not set to CreateGdnStandby, DBType is set to MySQL, and DBVersion is set to 8.0. The memory specification of the node with X-Engine enabled must be 8 GB or more
parameters.help_zh:
开启X-Engine存储引擎功能，取值范围如下：

ON：集群开启X-Engine引擎。
OFF：集群关闭X-Engine引擎。
当参数CreationOption不等于CreateGdnStandby，DBType为MySQL且DBVersion为8.0时，该参数才生效。开启X-Engine引擎的节点内存规格必须大于等于8 GB
parameters.name: loose_x_engine

parameters.help_en:
The percentage of memory allocated to the X-Engine storage engine. Valid values: integers from 10 to 90.
This parameter takes effect only when LooseXEngine is set to ON
parameters.help_zh:
设置开启X-Engine存储引擎比例，取值范围10~90的整数。
当参数LooseXEngine为ON时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: loose_x_engine_use_memory_pct

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for storage. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-by-capacity (pay-as-you-go).
Prepaid: pay-by-space (subscription)
parameters.help_zh:
存储计费类型。取值范围如下：

Postpaid：按容量计费（按量付费）。
Prepaid：按空间计费（包年包月）
parameters.name: storage_pay_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic storage scaling for Standard Edition clusters. Valid values:

Enable: enables automatic storage scaling.
Disable: disables automatic storage scaling
parameters.help_zh:
标准版集群是否开启存储自动扩容。取值范围如下：

Enable：开启存储自动扩容。
Disable：关闭存储自动扩容
parameters.name: storage_auto_scale

parameters.help_en:
The upper limit for automatic storage scaling of Standard Edition clusters. Unit: GB.

The maximum value is 32000
parameters.help_zh:
设置标准版集群存储自动扩容上限，单位：GB。

取值最大为32000
parameters.name: storage_upper_bound

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS for ESSD AutoPL cloud disks. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1000 × capacity - baseline performance}.

Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 × capacity, 50000}.

This parameter is supported only when StorageType is set to ESSDAUTOPL.
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50000}。

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数。
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable I/O performance burst for ESSD AutoPL cloud disks. Valid values:

true: enables I/O performance burst.
false: does not enable I/O performance burst (default).

This parameter is supported only when StorageType is set to ESSDAUTOPL
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘是否开启IO性能突发。取值：

true：开启
false：不开启（默认）

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数
parameters.name: bursting_enabled

parameters.help_en: The target minor engine version
parameters.help_zh: 目标内核小版本
parameters.name: target_minor_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cloud disk encryption. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled (default).
This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL.

This parameter takes effect only when StorageType is set to a Standard Edition storage type
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启云盘加密。取值范围如下：

true: 开启。
false: 关闭（默认值）。
当参数DBType为MySQL时，该参数才生效。

仅参数StorageType为标准版存储类型时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: storage_encryption

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a custom encryption key for cloud disk encryption in the same region as the instance. If you specify this parameter, cloud disk encryption is automatically enabled and cannot be disabled. To use the default service key for cloud disk encryption, leave this parameter empty.

You can view the key ID in the Key Management Service (KMS) console or create a new key.

This parameter takes effect only when DBType is set to MySQL.

This parameter takes effect only when StorageType is set to a Standard Edition storage type
parameters.help_zh:
实例同地域内的云盘加密自定义密钥 ID。传入此参数表示自动开启云盘加密（开启后无法关闭）。若使用默认的服务密钥进行云盘加密请留空该参数。

您可以在密钥管理服务控制台查看密钥 ID，也可以创建新的密钥。

当参数DBType为MySQL时，该参数才生效。

仅参数StorageType为标准版存储类型时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: storage_encryption_key

parameters.help_en: The UID of the account that owns the source backup set in a cross-account backup restoration scenario
parameters.help_zh: 跨账号备份恢复场景下源备份集所属uid
parameters.name: source_uid

parameters.help_en: The cloud service provider to which the instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的云服务商
parameters.name: cloud_provider

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node. This parameter is required when you create an ENS database
parameters.help_zh: 创建ENS数据库时，需要指定ENS的节点ID
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): Uses coupons.
false: Does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en:
The Agentic database engine type. Valid values:

dedicated
parameters.help_zh:
Agentic数据库引擎类型，取值范围如下：

dedicated
parameters.name: agentic_db_type

parameters.help_en: The Agentic cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: Agentic 集群 ID
parameters.name: agentic_db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The Agentic cluster description
parameters.help_zh: Agentic 集群描述
parameters.name: agentic_db_cluster_description
